summary: Algoma Steel Group Inc. furnished a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, attaching an October 1, 2026 press release providing preliminary third-quarter fiscal 2026 guidance. The Canadian steelmaker expects quarterly steel shipments of roughly 145,000 tons and Adjusted EBITDA of negative C$10 million to negative C$20 million, including a C$50 million to C$55 million capacity-utilization benefit. Management cited a Lake Superior Power turbine outage that constrained electric-arc-furnace production and sales mix; the turbine is replaced and EAF Unit Two commissioning continues. This is routine operational guidance, not a special situation; watch EAF Unit Two ramp timing and realized steel pricing.
